lesson: A rebase leaves refs/forge/stage/<id> baselines (decision 0023) pointing at pre-rebase commits, so stage done measures the whole upstream delta as the stage's diff ('changed N paths outside write_scope' listing upstream files). Fix: git update-ref each stage ref to the rebased equivalent commit, re-record the stage-local review (its base_sha binding goes stale), then stage done. Worktree-local .git/forge state and stage refs never rebase with the branch.
